source_axes: X right, Z up, facade outward -Y

WIN_FRAME_S.pivot: Wall plane Y=0, bottom-centre X=Z=0; outward -Y
WIN_FRAME_S.snapping: Nominal outer W x H includes sill/lintel; wall Y=0. Sill at floor +0.90 m.

WIN_FRAME_M.pivot: Wall plane Y=0, bottom-centre X=Z=0; outward -Y
WIN_FRAME_M.snapping: Nominal outer W x H includes sill/lintel; wall Y=0. Sill at floor +0.90 m.

WIN_FRAME_L.pivot: Wall plane Y=0, bottom-centre X=Z=0; outward -Y
WIN_FRAME_L.snapping: Nominal outer W x H includes sill/lintel; wall Y=0. Sill at floor +0.90 m.

WIN_SHUTTERS.pivot: Wall plane Y=0, bottom-centre X=Z=0; outward -Y
WIN_SHUTTERS.snapping: For WIN_FRAME_M. Same bottom as window; opened pair extends 0.58 m each side.

WIN_BARS.pivot: Wall plane Y=0, bottom-centre X=Z=0; outward -Y
WIN_BARS.snapping: Overlay WIN_FRAME_M; bottom aligned; stand-off beyond frame face. Ground floor only.

WIN_AC_UNIT.pivot: Wall plane Y=0, bottom-centre X=Z=0; outward -Y
WIN_AC_UNIT.snapping: Mount beside/below a window; origin on wall below housing. W .80 m.

BALCONY_SOVIET_OPEN.pivot: Wall plane Y=0, bottom-centre X=Z=0; outward -Y
BALCONY_SOVIET_OPEN.snapping: Width 3.0 m; slab underside at origin. Repeat at floor pitch 2.8 or 3.2 m.

BALCONY_GLAZED.pivot: Wall plane Y=0, bottom-centre X=Z=0; outward -Y
BALCONY_GLAZED.snapping: 3.0 m width; slab underside at floor. Wainscot uses one accent family per building.

CORNICE_1M.pivot: Wall plane Y=0, bottom-centre X=Z=0; outward -Y
CORNICE_1M.snapping: Tile along X at exactly 1 m pitch; flat end caps, no overlap.

CORNICE_2M.pivot: Wall plane Y=0, bottom-centre X=Z=0; outward -Y
CORNICE_2M.snapping: Tile along X at exactly 2 m pitch; flat end caps, no overlap.

CORNICE_CORNER.pivot: Convex wall corner (0,0,0), bottom of eaves
CORNICE_CORNER.snapping: Convex 90-degree turn. Connect straight ends at (-.50,0,0) and (0,.50,0).

LEDGE_FLOOR_1M.pivot: Wall plane Y=0, bottom-centre X=Z=0; outward -Y
LEDGE_FLOOR_1M.snapping: X pitch 1 m; Z=0 is lower edge of 0.22 m belt course.

PLINTH_1M.pivot: Wall plane Y=0, bottom-centre X=Z=0; outward -Y
PLINTH_1M.snapping: X pitch 1 m; ground Z=0; base-band height .50 m. Interrupt at doors.

PILASTER.pivot: Wall plane Y=0, bottom-centre X=Z=0; outward -Y
PILASTER.snapping: Stack vertically at 3.0 m pitch; width .40 m. End caps are square to prevent gaps.

CORNER_QUOINS.pivot: Convex wall corner (0,0,0), bottom of quoin stack
CORNER_QUOINS.snapping: Stack Z at 3 m pitch. Corner wraps front (-Y) and right (+X); no scaling.

DOOR_FRAME_ENTRANCE.pivot: Wall plane Y=0, bottom-centre X=Z=0; outward -Y
DOOR_FRAME_ENTRANCE.snapping: Outer 1.60 x 2.40 m; threshold at origin. Place above porch top .45 m.

DOOR_CANOPY.pivot: Wall plane Y=0, bottom-centre X=Z=0; outward -Y
DOOR_CANOPY.snapping: 2.40 m width, 1.50 m projection. Origin at underside of plate; mount at door top +.10 m.

PORCH_STEPS_3.pivot: Wall plane Y=0, bottom-centre X=Z=0; outward -Y
PORCH_STEPS_3.snapping: Ground-level origin on wall; three .15 m rises, .35 m treads; top Z=.45 m.

DRAINPIPE_SEGMENT_1M.pivot: Wall plane Y=0, bottom-centre X=Z=0; outward -Y
DRAINPIPE_SEGMENT_1M.snapping: Vertical Z pitch 1 m. Centreline Y=-.18 m, diameter .12 m; stack without scaling.

DRAINPIPE_ELBOW.pivot: Wall plane Y=0, bottom-centre X=Z=0; outward -Y
DRAINPIPE_ELBOW.snapping: Bottom socket centre (0,-.18,0); upper socket (0,-.48,.30). Fits 1 m segment.

DRAINPIPE_FUNNEL.pivot: Wall plane Y=0, bottom-centre X=Z=0; outward -Y
DRAINPIPE_FUNNEL.snapping: Lower socket centre (0,-.18,0); top catches roof/eaves. Connect segment below.

ROOF_PARAPET_1M.pivot: Wall plane Y=0, bottom-centre X=Z=0; outward -Y
ROOF_PARAPET_1M.snapping: X pitch 1 m. Z=0 on roof deck; cap width .40 m, cap underside Z=.65 m.

ROOF_CHIMNEY.pivot: Roof plane Z=0, footprint centre X=Y=0
ROOF_CHIMNEY.snapping: Roof-plane origin at footprint centre; .60 m brick shaft.

ROOF_VENT.pivot: Roof plane Z=0, footprint centre X=Y=0
ROOF_VENT.snapping: Footprint-centre origin on roof deck. Compact mushroom vent.

ROOF_WATER_TANK.pivot: Roof plane Z=0, footprint centre X=Y=0
ROOF_WATER_TANK.snapping: Roof-centre origin, 1.20 m tank diameter; three .10 m legs.

ROOF_SATELLITE_DISH.pivot: Roof plane Z=0, mast base centre X=Y=0
ROOF_SATELLITE_DISH.snapping: Roof-plane pivot on mast base; aim with Z rotation only.

ROOF_ANTENNA.pivot: Roof plane Z=0, mast base centre X=Y=0
ROOF_ANTENNA.snapping: Roof-centre origin. 1.8 m mast; broad .10 m antenna members.

SHOP_AWNING_STRIPED.pivot: Wall plane Y=0, bottom-centre X=Z=0; outward -Y
SHOP_AWNING_STRIPED.snapping: 3 m width; wall origin at lowest valance level, rear fixing +.60 m above it.

SHOP_SIGNBOARD_BLANK.pivot: Wall plane Y=0, bottom-centre X=Z=0; outward -Y
SHOP_SIGNBOARD_BLANK.snapping: 3 m width. Wall-plane bottom origin; blank face reserved for later text.

SHOP_ROLLER_SHUTTER.pivot: Wall plane Y=0, bottom-centre X=Z=0; outward -Y
SHOP_ROLLER_SHUTTER.snapping: 3 m wide x 2.4 m high; threshold at origin. Closed static shutter.

GARAGE_DOOR_METAL.pivot: Wall plane Y=0, bottom-centre X=Z=0; outward -Y
GARAGE_DOOR_METAL.snapping: 2.6 m wide x 2.3 m high; threshold at origin. Double-leaf silhouette.

FIRE_ESCAPE_STAIR_FLOOR.pivot: Wall plane Y=0 at lower landing centre, X=Z=0
FIRE_ESCAPE_STAIR_FLOOR.snapping: Rise 3.0 m, run 3.6 m + .9 m top platform; stack delta=(3.6,0,3). Mirror/alternate for dogleg.

GAS_PIPE_RUN_1M.pivot: Wall plane Y=0, bottom-centre X=Z=0; outward -Y
GAS_PIPE_RUN_1M.snapping: Horizontal X pitch 1 m; pipe centre Z=.06, Y=-.16. Use mustard palette yellow.

master_layout: 6-column review grid; translate to origin before exporting. Local pivot stays (0,0,0).
